quote:
I named mine Friday — I named my assistant Friday. It helps with the parts of my day I used to juggle myself — calendar, email, research, and the things I said I’d follow up on later.
What actually makes it useful is that it remembers. Not just the last chat. People, preferences, what’s going on this week. I can ask it to find a time, look into a company, or keep an eye on something, and it comes back without me babysitting it.
If you’ve tried other AIs and still feel like you’re the one doing all the work, this is the difference.
author: Junyuan Qi
